headline: Is Southern (SO) Fully Priced As Earnings And Battery Storage Hopes Build?
summary: Southern (SO) is back in focus after expectations for higher earnings per share and revenue, along with fresh battery storage projects and natural gas growth prospects, have drawn investor attention ahead of upcoming results. See our latest analysis for Southern. Southern’s share price has climbed 11.01% year to date and sits at $96.78, while a 50.87% three year total shareholder return signals steady long term gains as interest builds around earnings expectations and new battery storage...
